title: TRICARE Prime Network Copayment Schedule by Tier
content:
The fixed beneficiary copayments of **TRICARE Prime** are set per tier, per unit of service, for care received in the network (the emergency room copayment applies to network and non-network emergency rooms alike). Durable medical equipment is the one class charged as a percentage of the TRICARE allowed amount rather than as a fixed sum.

## Schedule

The first column covers five tiers that share every figure: TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member, TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member, TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member, TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member and TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor. All amounts are US dollars.

| Service class (unit) | The five active duty, family member and transitional survivor tiers | TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive care - clinical preventive services, well-child care, screenings (per visit) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Primary care outpatient visit (per visit) | 0.00 | 26.00 | 27.00 |
| Specialty care outpatient visit, referred (per visit) | 0.00 | 40.00 | 41.00 |
| Urgent care center visit (per visit) | 0.00 | 40.00 | 41.00 |
| Emergency room visit, network or non-network (per visit) | 0.00 | 81.00 | 84.00 |
| Ground ambulance (per trip) | 0.00 | 81.00 | 84.00 |
| Outpatient behavioral health, individual (per visit) | 0.00 | 26.00 | 27.00 |
| Outpatient behavioral health, group (per visit) | 0.00 | 13.00 | 14.00 |
| Physical, occupational or speech therapy (per visit) | 0.00 | 26.00 | 27.00 |
| Ambulatory surgery (per procedure) | 0.00 | 162.00 | 168.00 |
| Acute inpatient admission (per admission) | 0.00 | 194.00 | 201.00 |
| Inpatient mental health admission (per admission) | 0.00 | 194.00 | 201.00 |
| Laboratory and diagnostic radiology (per service) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Durable medical equipment (percent of the allowed amount) | 0 percent | 20 percent | 20 percent |

## Reading the schedule

- Each figure is the copayment for one unit of the class named: one visit, one trip, one procedure, one admission or one laboratory or radiology service.
- The durable medical equipment figure is a share of the allowed amount of the line, not a fixed sum: at 20 percent, an item with a hypothetical allowed amount of 250.00 carries 50.00.
- Preventive care and laboratory and diagnostic radiology carry 0.00 in every tier.

## Points of reference (figures taken from the table)

- A TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B enrollee's referred specialty visit carries 41.00; the same visit for a TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A enrollee carries 40.00.
- A TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member's emergency room visit carries 0.00, as does every class in the five tiers of the first column.
- A TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A enrollee's group behavioral health visit carries 13.00, half the 26.00 of an individual visit in that tier.
